answer: A guide earns his licence only after walking the dune route one hundred times beside a master, and the master's book records every crossing with its date. A nectar guide who learned the route from a map fails the licence: at the ledge of the crossing he must read the dunes the master knows, and a map reader walks into the sand. Buying a false licence means bribing a master, forging one hundred crossings and paying 21,500, while the kernel entry in the master's book is kept for life, so a guide whose crossings were never walked is left at the oasis.
